name: Checklist exposure + status history cards
description:
Make the per-task checklist actually used by agents (instead of writing steps in `description` or "DONE" in item titles) and visualize feature/phase/task status history as a chronological card stepper.

CURRENT STATE:
- `Task.checklist: ChecklistItem[]` exists (packages/plan-core/src/schema.ts:126,176) with `{ id, title, checked }`. `id` is a long internal slug (`${taskId}-check-NNN-slug`, packages/plan-core/src/naming.ts:107). There is NO short, human-referenceable per-item number (like F00x/P00x/T00x) — agents cannot say "check C2".
- MCP: `planner-task-add` (packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts:594) and `planner-task-discuss` (line 656, misnamed — really "persist notes/checklist") accept `checklist` as plain strings and write every item back as `checked: false`. `planner-task-update` (line 683) does NOT accept `checklist` at all. There is NO tool to toggle an item's `checked` flag — agents can only replace the whole list (losing checked state), which is why they write "DONE" in titles.
- pi-adapter: `planner-task-update` accepts `checklist` strings (packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts:3311) but also writes `checked: false`; no toggle.
- `task_complete` (plan-mcp:808, pi-adapter:3430) warns on unchecked items but cannot check them.
- Web UI: task-detail renders toggleable checkboxes (packages/plan-web-ui/src/routes/task-detail/route.tsx:23-69) via an HTML form POST to `.../checklist/:itemId/toggle` (router.tsx:91). task-EDIT modal has a checklist textarea; task-CREATE modal has NO checklist field. So checklists can only be added after creation.
- `Task.statusLog: StatusLogEntry[]` is persisted (schema.ts:146) and rendered in task-detail as a collapsible TEXT timeline (route.tsx:122-150). Not a card stepper.
- `Phase` and `Feature` have NO persisted status (derived from children at read time, schema.ts comments) and NO `statusLog` — so there is no status history for them.

GOALS:
1. Checklist items get a per-task `C{n}` number (1-based) so they are referenceable in chat/tool calls and shown as a badge in the Web UI.
2. Add `planner-task-checklist-toggle` MCP + pi-adapter tool: takes a task ref + `C{n}`/id/title + optional `checked` boolean, flips/sets `checked`. Add `checklist` param to `planner-task-update`. So agents can tick items instead of writing "DONE".
3. Web UI: add checklist field to task-CREATE modal; make task-detail checklist an always-open "Steps" section with `C{n}` badges + inline toggle; keep the edit-modal textarea.
4. Skill (`plugins/_shared/planner-skill.md.in`) + MCP tool descriptions instruct agents to put implementation steps in the checklist and tick via `planner-task-checklist-toggle`, not in `description`.
5. Persist `statusLog` on `Phase` and `Feature`: on each status rollup in PlanStore, compare new derived status to the last `statusLog` entry's `toStatus`; append a `StatusLogEntry` only on actual change. `status` itself stays unpersisted/derived (statusLog is just an audit trail).
6. New `StatusCardStepper` Web UI component: horizontal row of cards, one per transition in chronological order, each filled (status color + icon + timestamp) when reached. Replace task-detail text timeline with it; add to phase-detail + feature-detail.
7. Docs (README, CHECKLIST.md) + release:next.

BEHAVIORS TO PRESERVE: `task_complete` checklist enforcement (warn unless force); existing `id` stability; web UI toggle endpoint; status derivation principle (status stays derived, not persisted).
